name: booking-api-availability
user_journey: Clinic receptionist books, moves or cancels an appointment

sli.description: Proportion of valid booking API requests served successfully
sli.good_events: HTTP responses with status < 500 and latency below 2 s, excluding 429 from per-tenant rate limiting
sli.valid_events: All booking API requests from authenticated tenants, excluding synthetic health checks
sli.measurement: Load balancer request logs aggregated per minute

exclusion_policy: Planned maintenance announced 7 days ahead and capped at 30 minutes per month; incidents caused by a single tenant exceeding contractual quotas
error_budget_policy: If the 30-day budget is exhausted, feature releases pause until reliability work restores budget; exceptions need the product lead and SRE lead
